content.ascii:
AUTHOR -> VALIDATE -> RETAIN -> PUBLISH

AgentChat: supplied ASCII
  edit-diagram / create-diagram / extend-diagram
                  |
                  v
  ChatDiagramTools.prepare
  - resolve the bound canvas and current base revision
  - validate selected scope; batch uses one snapshot
                  |
                  v
  submitStoredDiagramEdit
                  |
                  v
  submitDiagramEdit
  - validate output + identity claims + source mappings
  - preserve lines outside selected replacement ranges
                  |
                  v
  createDiagram / reviseDiagram
  - DiagramRevisionEditor prepares and validates
  - issue frozen revision + logical node identities
                  |
                  v
  retainDiagramRevision
  - register revision; get/list by immutable identity
                  |
                  v
  MappingDocumentController
  - version check + install revision or store variant
  - reconcile anchors; append canvas history

Generator-based callers:
  generateDiagram -> generator.generate -> submitStoredDiagramEdit

Retention and canvas publication are separate steps.
A variant retains a candidate for later review or display.

Sources: chatDiagramTools.ts / submitDiagramEdit.ts
         diagramRevision.ts / diagramRevisionStore.ts
         generateDiagram.ts / mappingDocumentController.ts
